verdicts.reason: A breaks the design into scattered pieces. The SOLSTICE logo is a tiny floating mark at the left edge, the legal text is nearly as large as the subhead, and the LONGEST DAY SALE badge and Claim the Deal button are small and pushed into the right corner, so the call to action gets lost. B gives the logo and a larger call to action a clearer place, but the button sits right against the end of the one-line headline. Its bottle is shrunk at the left edge with a decorative circle running into it, the sale banner floats loose at the bottom left, and the legal text breaks with an orphaned 'Co., 2026.' that has a dot over it.
